description: Returns the official American Ghost Walks booking link for a tour, plus what to pick on its calendar. The guest chooses the date, time and tickets and pays on that page; this tool does not reserve or charge anything. Share the returned URL exactly as given.

date.description: Local calendar date the guest should pick on the booking page, as YYYY-MM-DD.

party_size.description: Optional number of guests (integer 1-50) to mention in the booking instructions.

time.description: Optional departure time in 24-hour HH:MM from get_availability (e.g. '19:30'). Do not pass '7:30 pm'; convert to HH:MM first.

tour.description: Tour identifier from search_tours.tour_id (preferred slug, e.g. 'chicago-ghost-tour'), or the exact tour name.

name: get_booking_link
title: Get booking link
